title: Scripture and Obedience
definition: Scripture and Obedience means God’s Word calls believers to respond to His truth with faithful action.
summary: Scripture and Obedience means God’s Word calls believers to respond to His truth with faithful action.
christFocus: Jesus obeyed the Father perfectly and now calls His disciples to hear His Word and follow Him in Spirit-empowered obedience.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Obedience is the proper response to God’s Word. Scripture is not given merely to be admired, debated, or collected. It is given to be believed and lived.

Biblical obedience is not legalism when it flows from faith in Christ. Believers obey because they have been loved, forgiven, and made new. The Holy Spirit empowers obedience that the flesh cannot produce.

Jesus connects hearing and doing. A life built on His Word stands because it rests on Him. Obedience does not earn salvation; it shows that the Word has been received with faith.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Some people use Bible knowledge to avoid surrender. Others fear obedience because they have experienced harsh religion. Scripture and obedience correct both errors by showing that Christ calls His people into life-giving faithfulness.

This doctrine is vital for recovery and discipleship because freedom is not only being forgiven; it is learning to walk in a new direction by grace.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Ask where Scripture is calling you to respond today. Do not settle for hearing truth without action. By the Spirit’s power, take one concrete step of repentance, forgiveness, honesty, service, worship, or obedience to Christ.
